method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module (built-in date functions, no daydate), the rules in one module and the worker's questions in a seat module importing it; three regulative rules (s 113(1), s 38(4)(b), s 231(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety Act 2012 (Tas), No. 1 of 2012, consolidated version published 2025-09-16 and current at point in time 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2012-001.txt (text sha256 20762d69e201304dce10e4c411a142fe6b6f981dfa9b50b422423685b6a41a1e), retrieved from legislation.tas.gov.au on 2026-11-06; includes the industrial manslaughter amendments of No. 15 of 2024 (applied 2 October 2024)

seat: the worker: the individual (or prospective worker) who is hurt, put at risk, stops unsafe work, or is treated badly for raising safety, and who brings or presses a claim about it -- or, where a worker has died, the family member asking on the worker's behalf (twhs-seat.l4); the business, the regulator, inspectors and the courts get no seat

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run twhs-dates.l4 ; l4 run twhs-rules.l4 ; l4 run twhs-seat.l4 ; l4 run twhs-cases.l4
checks.result: 210 assertions written, 210 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range; a deliberately wrong assertion was run once in a scratch file (since deleted) to confirm a failure shows as DiagnosticSeverity_Error. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. In: ss 5 (so far as s 5(1), (7) bear on who is a worker), 7, 19(1), (2), 28(c), Part 2 Division 4A (ss 29B, 29C, 29D) and Division 5 (ss 30-34), Part 3 (ss 35-39), Part 5 Division 6 (ss 83-88), Part 6 (ss 104-115), s 184, ss 231, 232, 267, 272, 273. Out: Part 1 machinery (ss 1-4, 6, 8-12); Part 2 Division 1 (principles; 'reasonably practicable' is a judgment), ss 19(3)-(5), 20-27, 28(a), (b), (d), 29 (duties of others; folded into the 'a health and safety duty was owed' fact); Part 4; Part 5 Divisions 1-5, 7, 8 (consultation, representatives, committees, issue resolution, provisional improvement notices); s 89; Part 7; Parts 8-12 except s 184; Part 13 except ss 231, 232, 267 (s 260 cited); Part 14 except ss 272, 273; Schedules. Reasons in NOTES.md.
